events.title: Mid-day Save/Load, Watch Item, Tutorial Menu, Other Improvements + Next Fest!
events.summary: The Atrium has successfully entered Steam's Next Fest starting today! To celebrate, I thought I'd bring my biggest update yet, which allows for saving and loading games mid-way through a run, meaning you don't have to sleep or die to save, and I also added many other improvements and bug fixes, such as a diagnostic watch item that allows you to see your health and stamina bars, among other stats.New Content/Functionality:Save system improved to allow players to quit the game at any point in the

events.title: Added Lore Note System + Bug Fixes
events.summary: Content Updates:Added a lore note system to the game, where lore notes will spawn throughout the caves, that you can view, which will be stored at your base if you want to view them again. These should help to give a bit more context to the game's mechanics and also add a bit of lore/interest.Bug Fixes:Fixed a bug where "reset to defaults" wouldn't reset the shadow quality in graphics settingsFixed a bug where the cassette player tutorial arrow would sometimes appear after loading the game, even

events.title: Added crafting recipe pin system + VFX for lit explosives
events.summary: Content Updates:Added a crafting recipe pinning system that allows you to pin crafting recipes to receive a notification when you obtain enough resources to craft the pinned items.Added VFX to cave explosives that have been lit, that happen along with the fuse SFXImprovements/Changes:Added a tutorial prompt that points to the cassette player to make it less easy to missWorld-space tutorial prompt arrows are now unable to be obscured by geometry, and don't clip through geometry.Thanks to everyone

events.title: UI/Options Bug Fixes
events.summary: Bug Fixes;Fixed a bug where the player was unable to change the bindings in the keybindings menuFixed a bug where the resolution drop-down in the display settings expanded upwards and off-screenAdded a scroll-bar to the resolution dropdown in the display settings to account for high numbers of resolution options"Photosensitivity Warning" on the boot screen, and the loading dots indicator, now both scale correctly with different aspect ratiosClicking on a dropdown while it is open will now close

events.title: Added mining speed entry in "more info" menu + slightly changed an upgrade
events.summary: Improvements/Changes:Added an entry in the "more info" menu to explain the purpose of the mining speed stat for toolsChanged the values of the ore gamble upgrade such that now it has a 50/50 chance of giving 60% more resources, or 40% less, rather than 50/50%, making it more usefulJust a small update today. I think the demo build should be pretty much finalised now, as there don't seem to be any more changes that need making :)

events.title: Major balancing bug fixes + other improvements/changes
events.summary: For everybody that was having trouble with slow progression, this update should finally fix these issues! What I thought was just a balancing issue turned out to actually be a bug that was preventing resources from spawning a lot of the time, leading to sparse tunnels. The progression should now be more consistent as objects generate more consistently, and some balancing changes have been made to streamline progression even more :)Bug Fixes:Fixed a bug that was causing resources/food/explosives

events.title: Fixed a bug preventing players from picking up upgrades.
events.summary: Fixed a bug that was preventing players from picking up upgrades. Really sorry to everybody that this affected! It should now be fixed when you go back into the game.Also fixed color banding visual issues on collectible/cassette close-up views.

events.title: The Atrium Demo is out now!
events.summary: Playtesting has concluded and thus, the free demo is now live for everyone to play!In this demo, you can explore the first couple of biomes and craft a selection of the tools and upgrades offered in the full game, giving you a glimpse of what lies below.Hope you all enjoy the demo :)
